name: Knott's Mrs. Knott's Deep-Dish Boysenberry Pie (Berry Seed Stricture Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: The legendary pie that started the theme park! However, deep-dish boysenberry pie is densely packed with millions of tough, insoluble boysenberry seeds that pose a severe mechanical obstruction risk.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid if stricture-prone or in active flares. In remission, enjoy a boysenberry scone or seedless boysenberry soft-serve instead.
watchOuts: Dense boysenberry seeds are notorious stricture blockage triggers
